mapper.update: UPDATE bi_report_definition SET report_code = #{reportCode}, report_name = #{reportName}, report_type = #{reportType}, data_source = #{dataSource}, query_text = #{queryText}, permission_code = #{permissionCode}, data_level = #{dataLevel}, description = #{description}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.select: SELECT report_id, tenant_id, report_code, report_name, report_type, data_source, query_text, permission_code, data_level, description, created_at, updated_at FROM bi_report_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE bi_metric_definition SET metric_code = #{metricCode}, metric_name = #{metricName}, category = #{category}, formula = #{formula}, unit = #{unit}, permission_code = #{permissionCode}, data_level = #{dataLevel}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND metric_id = #{metricId}
